The New York Times app?
Unlocked?
Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能让你免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间越过付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: At about 2 o'clock, everyone begins to gather for what had been one of the most popular activities before the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 大约两点钟，大家开始聚集在一起，参加疫情前最受欢迎的活动之一。

sentences.en: A penny auction.
All of the residents get pennies, which they can use to bid.
sentences.zh: 所有的居民都会得到一分钱硬币，他们可以用这些硬币来竞拍。

sentences.en: And there's a big table at the front of the room where a bunch of auction items are set up.
sentences.zh: 房间前头有一张大桌子，上面摆放着一堆拍卖品。

sentences.en: There are cookies and quilts and a stuffed Snoopy.
sentences.zh: 有饼干、被子和一个史努比毛绒玩具。

sentences.en: And all around, residents are spread out in a maze of socially distanced wheelchairs.
sentences.zh: 周围，居民们分散在保持社交距离的轮椅迷宫中。

sentences.en: Betty Lou is there.
Hi again.
And so is Zita.
Zita, hi.
It takes her a second to recognize me because I'm covered in PPE.
sentences.zh: 她花了一秒钟才认出我，因为我全身都穿着个人防护装备。

sentences.en: I didn't know who you are.
Well, I know.
You can't recognize me without the stuff on.
sentences.zh: 你不穿这身装备就认不出我了。

sentences.en: And eventually, we get started.
Here we go.
The first item up is a handbag.
sentences.zh: 第一件拍卖品是一个手提包。

sentences.en: With a few things in it.
A body spray, a toothbrush, a toothpaste, ladies' deodorant.
sentences.zh: 一瓶身体喷雾、一把牙刷、一支牙膏、女士除臭剂。

sentences.en: Then there's a light-up St. Patrick's Day necklace.
sentences.zh: 然后是一条会发光的圣帕特里克节项链。

sentences.en: Oh, that's nice.
Thanks.
Put it on you.
Put it on me.
Look at that.
Oh, sweet.
I'm working.
But the hot ticket item?
sentences.zh: 但最抢手的商品是什么呢？

sentences.en: Who likes cheese puffs?
A giant tub of cheese puffs.
Dwighter 6, Marcy, Dwighter 7, Zita, Dwighter 8.
sentences.zh: 德怀特6号、玛西、德怀特7号、齐塔、德怀特8号。

sentences.en: And Betty Lou, who's been awfully quiet so far, decides to go all in.
sentences.zh: 而一直非常安静的贝蒂·卢决定全力以赴。

sentences.en: I've been waiting for it.
Aw.
And ends up taking home the prize.
sentences.zh: 最后她把奖品带回了家。

sentences.en: You won't forgive anybody, Annie.
What's that?
So, Betty, you spent all your pennies on cheese puffs?
sentences.zh: 所以，贝蒂，你把你所有的钱都花在芝士泡芙上了？

sentences.en: Those are good snacks.
I'm done.
That's good snack.
Are you happy with your purchase?
sentences.zh: 你对你的战利品满意吗？

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
Thank you all for coming down for the auction today.
sentences.zh: 感谢大家今天来参加拍卖会。

sentences.en: We're so lucky we got to do this today.
sentences.zh: 我们真幸运今天能做到这一点。

sentences.en: Thank you.
Okay, so it's about 4 o'clock, and we've had a really full day so far going to lunch in the dining room and then the penny auction, which was a huge hit.
sentences.zh: 好了，现在大约是4点钟，我们今天过得非常充实，先是在餐厅吃了午餐，然后是拍卖会，非常受欢迎。

sentences.en: I'm about to call a nurse who worked on the COVID unit but is off today, and so I'm going to try her on her cell phone if she picks up.
sentences.zh: 我正要给一位在新冠病房工作但今天休息的护士打电话，如果她接听的话，我会试着打她的手机。

sentences.en: Hi.
Is this Carol?
Yes, it is.
Hi, Carol.
Carol Smay has been a good shepherd for almost four years.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔·斯梅在“好牧人”工作了近四年。

sentences.en: How hard has this past year been?
Like, what has been the hardest part of this past year?
sentences.zh: 比如，过去这一年最艰难的部分是什么？

sentences.en: The fact that these folks have been separated from their families has been very difficult.
sentences.zh: 这些人与家人分离的事实非常困难。

sentences.en: I feel that a lot of them, because of not being able to see their families, beyond just health care.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他们中的很多人，因为无法见到家人，这不仅仅是医疗保健的问题。

sentences.en: The nursing home had been mostly spared early on in the pandemic, but it suffered a COVID outbreak in November.
sentences.zh: 这家疗养院在疫情初期基本幸免于难，但在11月遭受了新冠疫情的爆发。

sentences.en: Carol took care of those patients.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔照顾了那些病人。

sentences.en: We had one guy who passed and who, I mean, he's the one that strikes me the most because
sentences.zh: 我们有一个去世的人，我的意思是，他是最让我印象深刻的一个，因为

sentences.en: he was a very positive, upbeat kind of guy.
sentences.zh: 他是一个非常积极、乐观的人。

sentences.en: And before the pandemic, he made a point of always getting around to every single unit, talking to everybody, the staff, the residents.
sentences.zh: 疫情之前，他总是特意去每个单元，和每个人交谈，包括员工和居民。

sentences.en: He was always excited about going to dining room, any activity that was occurring.
sentences.zh: 他总是对去餐厅或参加任何正在进行的活动感到兴奋。

sentences.en: You know, he knew what was going on every single day because he had a lot of physical disabilities, but he had a very clear mind.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他每天都知道发生了什么，因为他虽然有很多身体残疾，但头脑非常清醒。

sentences.en: And I used to tell him he was my hero because in spite of what would appear to have been, in terms of his physical disabilities,
sentences.zh: 我过去常告诉他他是我的英雄，因为尽管从他的身体残疾来看，似乎

sentences.en: be a kind of what you'd say, a raw deal.
sentences.zh: 怎么说呢，命运对他很不公。

sentences.en: He was always so positive and so upbeat.
sentences.zh: 他总是那么积极，那么乐观。

sentences.en: I say, you're the morale officer of the building when he would come by, you know, because I said, you're always in such a good mood and always so happy.
sentences.zh: 当他过来时，我说，你是这栋楼的士气官，你知道，因为我说，你总是心情这么好，总是这么快乐。

sentences.en: And he's one of the ones that died.
sentences.zh: 而他就是去世的人之一。

sentences.en: Wow.
That was very hard.
And were you treating him?
Yes.
I mean, he was in the COVID unit, so yes.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他在新冠病房，所以是的。

sentences.en: It sounds like you were close with him, too.
sentences.zh: 听起来你和他也很亲近。

sentences.en: Everybody was.
And as the day goes on, I realize there's one person I still need to talk to.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，我意识到还有一个人我需要谈谈。

sentences.en: And that's Don Kirsch, the administrator of the nursing home.
sentences.zh: 那就是疗养院的管理员唐·基尔什。

sentences.en: He's the one who gave the orders to shut down last year.
And he's also the one who ultimately gave the OK to come out of lockdown.
sentences.zh: 也是他最终批准解除封锁的。

sentences.en: OK, I see you wrote this down.
sentences.zh: 好的，我看到你写下来了。

sentences.en: So just some thoughts.
And as we sit down, he pulls out a statement that he's typed up on a piece of paper.
sentences.zh: 当我们坐下时，他拿出一份他在纸上打印好的声明。

sentences.en: Do you want to just maybe read this for the audio in your own voice or read, you know, parts of it?
sentences.zh: 你想用你自己的声音为录音读一下这个，或者读其中的一部分吗？

sentences.en: Tragically, we experienced a coronavirus outbreak in November of 2020, infecting 20 residents, resulting in five resident deaths.
sentences.zh: 悲剧的是，我们在2020年11月经历了新冠疫情爆发，感染了20名居民，导致5名居民死亡。

sentences.en: We are brokenhearted by this loss of life.
sentences.zh: 我们对这些生命的逝去感到心碎。

sentences.en: These individuals and their loved ones are in our thoughts and prayers each day.
sentences.zh: 这些逝者和他们的亲人每天都在我们的思念和祈祷中。

sentences.en: This is a really, it's been an emotional time this past year.
sentences.zh: 这真的是，过去这一年是一段充满情感的时期。

sentences.en: And so tell me why, you know, when you were talking about what you've been through, you got a little choked up.
sentences.zh: 所以告诉我为什么，你知道，当你谈论你所经历的事情时，你有点哽咽了。

sentences.en: Tell me, tell me more about that.
sentences.zh: 告诉我，多告诉我一些关于那件事的情况。

sentences.en: Well, it's, Sarah, it's been the greatest challenge of our careers.
sentences.zh: 嗯，莎拉，这是我们职业生涯中最大的挑战。

sentences.en: And I'm not only speaking for myself, but for all of our staff.
sentences.zh: 我不仅是代表我自己，也是代表我们所有的员工。

sentences.en: Wheeling is such a tight knit community.
sentences.zh: 惠灵是一个非常紧密的社区。

sentences.en: We know each other.
A lot of us have grown up together.
sentences.zh: 我们很多人是一起长大的。

sentences.en: And we had the pleasure of taking care of individuals in the time in their lives other than childhood, possibly when they needed others the moSt.
sentences.zh: 我们有幸在他们生命中除了童年以外的时期照顾他们，可能是在他们最需要别人帮助的时候。

sentences.en: To find the right words.
I better start it for, I'm sorry.
That's okay.
I'm really sorry.
As I was saying, our staff has handled this with tremendous professionalism.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，我们的员工以极大的专业精神处理了这件事。

sentences.en: They worked morning, noon, and night volunteering oftentimes to work over and to stay with residents or sit with residents.
sentences.zh: 他们从早到晚工作，经常自愿加班，陪伴居民或坐在居民身边。

sentences.en: I have tremendous respect, love, and admiration for our staff.
sentences.zh: 我对我们的员工怀有极大的尊重、爱和钦佩。

sentences.en: And how long have you been the administrator here at Good Shepherd?
sentences.zh: 你在“好牧人”担任管理员多久了？

sentences.en: This June, it'll be 40 years.
And in those 40 years, have you ever experienced anything like this?
sentences.zh: 在这40年里，你经历过这样的事情吗？

sentences.en: No, as I said, this has been the greatest challenge of a lifetime.
sentences.zh: 没有，正如我所说，这是我一生中最大的挑战。

sentences.en: Are there days that stand out to you during the pandemic as being pivotal?
sentences.zh: 在疫情期间，有没有哪几天对你来说是关键的？

sentences.en: Two days stood out when we began to see what was happening throughout the state of West Virginia.
sentences.zh: 当我们开始看到西弗吉尼亚州各地发生的情况时，有两天很突出。

sentences.en: I had made the decision on March 11th to close the facility to outside visitors.
sentences.zh: 我在3月11日做出了决定，禁止外部访客进入该设施。

sentences.en: The other day that stands out to us was December 23rd of last year, when our residents received the first dose of the Moderna vaccine.
sentences.zh: 另一天对我们来说很突出的是去年的12月23日，当时我们的居民接种了第一剂莫德纳疫苗。

sentences.en: I felt
for the first time in all of those months that we might have the chance of having the upper hand against this virus and that we might be able to begin to see the light at the end of the tunnel.
sentences.zh: 在所有这些月里，我第一次觉得我们可能有机会战胜这种病毒，并且我们可能开始看到隧道尽头的曙光。

sentences.en: You know, I feel a tremendous sense of responsibility for these individuals and a tremendous sense of accountability to them and to their family members.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我对这些人有一种巨大的责任感，对他们和他们的家人有一种巨大的问责感。

sentences.en: So there's been a tremendous number of sleepless nights, a tremendous amount of praying to God for an answer.
sentences.zh: 所以有无数个不眠之夜，有无数次向上帝祈求答案。

sentences.en: And I hope we're at that point right now.
sentences.zh: 我希望我们现在已经到了那个阶段。

sentences.en: But I will say at the same time, I feel that I've had no more or no less weight than any other staff member here.
sentences.zh: 但我同时也要说，我觉得我所承受的压力并不比这里的任何其他员工多或少。

sentences.en: We're all in this together and we share equally in the joy and in the pain.
sentences.zh: 我们都在一起，我们共同分担快乐和痛苦。

sentences.en: Yeah, that makes sense.
I guess before you go, you did read the statement about the five people who died,
sentences.zh: 我想在你走之前，你确实读了关于那五名去世者的声明，

sentences.en: but I do think it's important to talk a little bit about that and about what you can say about them.
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为谈谈这件事以及你能说些什么很重要。

sentences.en: Whether there's something specific about each of those people that you know or just the loss and sort of acknowledging that.
sentences.zh: 无论是关于这些人中每一个人的具体情况，还是仅仅是关于那种损失并承认这一点。

sentences.en: I will say that I knew each one of them personally, as I tried to know all of our residents personally.
sentences.zh: 我会说我亲自认识他们每一个人，就像我努力亲自认识我们所有的居民一样。

sentences.en: And I just have a terrible sense of regret and apology to them and to their families.
sentences.zh: 我只是对他们和他们的家人感到一种可怕的遗憾和歉意。

sentences.en: I feel as if, as administrator of this facility, that I let them down.
sentences.zh: 我觉得作为这个设施的管理员，我辜负了他们。

sentences.en: And that's something I'll carry with me for the rest of my life.
sentences.zh: 这是我余生都会随身携带的东西。

sentences.en: I couldn't keep the virus from taking their lives.
sentences.zh: 我无法阻止病毒夺走他们的生命。

sentences.en: I will be so much more happy, Sarah, when their family members are able to come in and see their loved ones again.
sentences.zh: 莎拉，当他们的家人能够进来再次见到他们所爱的人时，我会高兴得多。

sentences.en: There's no substitute for a one-on-one visit and that love and affection that cannot come through an electronic device.
sentences.zh: 面对面的探访是无可替代的，那种爱和情感是无法通过电子设备传递的。

sentences.en: Well, thank you so much for your time, Mr. Kirsch.
sentences.zh: 好的，非常感谢您抽出时间，基尔希先生。

sentences.en: I really appreciate it.
It's Don.
It's Don.
Okay.
Everyone here calls you Mr. Kirsch.
sentences.zh: 这里每个人都叫您基尔希先生。

sentences.en: Okay.
That sounds good.
We'll be here for Bunko later.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后会留下来参加邦科游戏。

sentences.en: Did anyone, did your parents, did your parents explain Bunko to you?
sentences.zh: 有人，或者说您的父母，您的父母有没有给您解释过邦科游戏？

sentences.en: You know, I think Zeta explained Bunko.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我想是齐塔解释的。

sentences.en: Oh, okay.
Yeah.
Yeah, she's something, isn't she?
She said something about dice and getting to 23.
sentences.zh: 她提到了骰子，还有凑到23点什么的。

sentences.en: Around 7 o'clock, I head to the final event of the day, a dice game called Bunko.
sentences.zh: 大约7点钟，我前往当天的最后一项活动，一个叫邦科的骰子游戏。

sentences.en: Who's in charge?
Is Zeta in charge?
It's Zeta.
Betty Lou and Zeta are there, along with three others.
sentences.zh: 贝蒂·卢和齐塔都在那儿，还有另外三个人。

sentences.en: They're sitting around a table, and they each have a small cup of cheese puffs in front of them.
sentences.zh: 她们围坐在一张桌子旁，每个人面前都有一小杯芝士泡芙。

sentences.en: Betty Lou had brought her auction winnings to share.
sentences.zh: 贝蒂·卢带来了她拍卖赢来的奖品和大家分享。

sentences.en: Oh, she won Bunko.
You won, June.
I did, yeah.
You won Bunko.
I can't say so.
As the day draws to a close, I think about what this time at Good Shepherd tells us about the return to normalcy after the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 随着这一天接近尾声，我思考着在好牧人养老院的这段时光告诉了我们什么关于疫情后回归常态的信息。

sentences.en: There may have been an off switch at the beginning, but I realize there will be no on switch, no one instant when everything goes back to normal.
sentences.zh: 起初可能有一个关闭开关，但我意识到不会有一个开启开关，不会有那么一个瞬间让一切恢复正常。

sentences.en: But more and more, we may find moments of healing and togetherness, a shared coffee over lunch, a dice game with friends.
sentences.zh: 但我们可能会越来越多地发现治愈和团聚的时刻，午餐时分享的一杯咖啡，与朋友玩的一场骰子游戏。

sentences.en: Okay, girls, it was a really nice plan for a change.
sentences.zh: 好了，姑娘们，这次的计划真的很不错，换换口味挺好。

sentences.en: Betty Lou, what did you think?
Lunch and penny auction.
Oh my gosh, it's been a busy day.
Goodness sakes.
How do you feel at the end of the day?
sentences.zh: 这一天结束时你感觉如何？

sentences.en: How do I feel today?
Tonight, right now.
Right now.
I feel very happy about today.
sentences.zh: 我对今天感到非常高兴。

sentences.en: Well, it's nice meeting you.
Nice meeting you.
Do you think you'll ever come back down this week?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这周还会再下来吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I think probably one day.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想大概会有一天吧。

sentences.en: There's a girl.
I got your feet up and it was so good to see you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我把你的脚抬起来了，很高兴明天能见到你。

sentences.en: Very nice.
Oh, thanks for listening to me.
Thank you, Zita.
It was such a pleasure.
I loved getting to know you and I'm so glad you got to play Bungo.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴能认识你，也很高兴你能玩上邦科游戏。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
Yeah.
In a series of new guidelines for nursing homes released in recent weeks, the Biden administration
sentences.zh: 在最近几周发布的一系列针对养老院的新指南中，拜登政府

sentences.en: recommended that guests should be allowed to visit the residents inside of them, regardless of whether they or the residents have been vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 建议允许访客进入养老院探望住户，无论他们或住户是否接种过疫苗。

sentences.en: In explaining the change, federal health officials cited the millions of vaccines already administered
sentences.zh: 在解释这一变化时，联邦卫生官员提到了已经接种的数百万剂疫苗

sentences.en: to nursing home residents and staff, as well as the, quote, psychological, emotional, and physical toll of keeping nursing home residents separated from their families.
sentences.zh: 以及养老院住户和工作人员的情况，并引用了“心理、情感和身体上的代价”，即让养老院住户与家人分离所带来的影响。

sentences.en: The Good Shepherd Nursing Home is now open to visitors.
sentences.zh: 好牧人养老院现在对访客开放了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: What I'm worried about is how un-American this whole initiative is.
sentences.zh: 我担心的是，整个倡议是多么的不符合美国精神。

sentences.en: It's sick.
It's sick.
During his first formal news conference as president, Joe Biden denounced the growing
sentences.zh: 在担任总统后的首次正式新闻发布会上，乔·拜登谴责了日益增长的

sentences.en: attempts by Republican state legislators to restrict access to voting, calling it a disgraceful strategy that recalled the days of Jim Crow in the American South.
sentences.zh: 共和党州议员限制投票权的企图，称这是一种可耻的策略，让人回想起美国南方吉姆·克劳法的时代。

sentences.en: The Republican voters I know find this despicable.
sentences.zh: 我认识的共和党选民觉得这很卑鄙。

sentences.en: Republican voters.
Asked about the filibuster rule in the Senate, which requires 60 votes to pass legislation and

For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.

sentences.en: Until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天，选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，该党一直处于一场痛苦、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。
